facts.text: The Cave of Evil, also known as the dark-side cave, was a large and living dark side vergence located under a gnarltree on the swamp planet of Dagobah. Entering the cave subjected entrants to the vergence's control, projecting their worst fears as apparitions and illusions.

facts.text: Dragonsnake Bog was a murky lagoon located on the swamp planet of Dagobah. It was named after its most dangerous occupant, a giant snake-like beast called the dragonsnake.

evidence.quote: Dragonsnake Bog was a murky lagoon located on the swamp planet of Dagobah. It was named after its most dangerous occupant, a giant snake-like beast called the dragonsnake.

facts.text: Mount Dagger was a mostly-eroded shield volcano on the planet Dagobah. It was the only prominent natural formation on the planet.

evidence.quote: Mount Dagger was a mostly-eroded shield volcano on the planet Dagobah. It was the only prominent natural formation on the planet.

facts.text: Yoda's Hut was the last residence of Yoda, Grand Master of the Jedi Order, during his years of self-imposed exile on Dagobah. Initially, Yoda used the E3-standard starship lifeboat that had brought him to Dagobah as a temporary shelter.

facts.text: The Cave of Evil, also known as the Dark Side Cave, was a cave on Dagobah containing a powerful dark-side manifestation of the Force.

facts.text: The Shelter was home to the 25 descendants of a survey team to Dagobah. A small island of dry ground, it held between 20 and 30 huts.

facts.text: Mount Yoda, originally called Mount Dagger, was an enormous shield volcano on Dagobah that dated from the early years of that planet's formation, billions of years in the past.
